product_metadata.title: EZ SPARES Quiet Carpet Sweeper,Floor Sweeper with Pig-Bristles,Suitable for Carpet Cleaning Power,Roller Brush Strong,Bristle Sweeper,Great for House,Office,Kitchen,Carpet(Silver)
features: 【Pig-Bristles】Bristle refers to the pig's neck and the spine of the growth of more than 5 centimeters of bristles. Tough and elastic, not easy to deformation, moisture resistance, not affected by heat and cold.Pig-Bristles brushes affordable,last longer.

【Need a QUICK and EASY clean-ups? 】Try EZ SPARES sweep machine at once. Simply push this manual sweeper forward - its rotating brushes will lift and sweep up the dirt and into the built-in dustpan.You can clean your floor with one hand.Say goodbye to your dustpan now.

【Works on ALL Hard floor surfaces】For Wood, Linoleum,more suitable for carpet and rug. with NO scuffing or scratching.The Pig-Bristles brushes have fabulous picks up power for pet hair, crumbs, dust, debris, paper clips, glass and more. Easily dump garbage by holding on the push button.
【Lightweight and Convenient】Weighs less than 2 pounds and folds flat for hard to reach flat areas(Bed bottom, sofa bottom) and easy storage.Corner brushes for cleaning in corners and along edges.
Designed and manufactured by EZ SPARES.Good quality and long service life.If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
